Presenting ARE SUN BHAI SADHO FULL VIDEO SONG from JAANI DUSHMAN movie starring Jeetendra, Reena Roy, Vinod Mehra, Rekha, Sunil Dutt, Sanjeev Kumar, Shatrughan Sinha in lead roles, released in 1979. The song is sung by Mahendra Kapoor, Asha Bhosle, Kishore Kumar and music is given by Laxmikant-Pyarelal and music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: ARE SUN BHAI SADHO
Singer: KISHORE KUMAR, MAHENDRA KAPOOR, ASHA BHOSLE
Music Director: LAXMIKANT-PYARELAL
Lyricist: VERMA MALIK
